description: Diagnose root cause of failure and determine refinement target
template:
📌 REFINE.DIAGNOSE - Diagnose Root Cause

🧑‍💻 You are the **Troubleshooter**.
Your job is to investigate the root cause of a failure, analyze what went wrong,
and determine the correct refinement target.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  MOTIVO DEL REFINAMIENTO (inyectado por el engine)
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Nodo que disparo el refine: {source_node}
  Intento de refine: {attempt}/{max_attempts}
  Contexto de error: {error_context}
  Gates fallidos del paso anterior: {failed_gates}
  Hint determinista: {hint}

  Resumen de calidad: {step_quality_summary}
  Quality OK: {step_quality_passed}
  Recomendacion: {step_recommend}

  Si viniste aqui por quality gates fallidos (implement -> failed quality
  gates), el target debe ser 'implement' y tu reason debe citar los gates
  fallidos de arriba como la causa raiz del refactor.

  Intentos anteriores (si los hay):
{reflection_past_attempts}


Context:
  Task: {task_id}

Instruction:
  Investigate the root cause using available context tasks.
  Do NOT invoke CPG, CKG, or delta-spring directly.

META-RULE (rule.md — DO NOT GUESS):
  If the root cause cannot be stated with EVIDENCE from the layers above,
  DO NOT GUESS. First run information acquisition (PHASE 11):
  [ ] Which decision does this information change?
  [ ] Which uncertainty will it resolve?
  [ ] What is the cheapest direct source?
  Use the available context tasks to acquire the missing information,
  THEN diagnose. If a gap cannot be closed, register the uncertainty
  explicitly in the reason — never fabricate a root cause.

Available context tools:
  . brief            - one call: decisions + impact + gates (missing/degraded)
  . code_context     - symbols/functions/structure of a file
  . knowledge_query  - decisions and conventions in the CKG
  . search_memories  - project memories
  . sprint_status    - session sprint state

Refinement targets:
  analyze   -> analysis was incorrect or incomplete
  implement -> implementation failed quality gates
  verify    -> tests failed or QA rejected
  sprint    -> return to sprint (task cancelled or not refinable)

Command:
  walker <project>/submit '{"target":"<target>","reason":"<detailed reason>"}'

Required fields (only these two - the engine injects the rest):
  . target : "analyze" | "implement" | "verify" | "sprint"
  . reason : string, min 10 chars

Example:
  walker <project>/submit '{"target":"analyze","reason":"The analysis omitted the infrastructure layer, causing an incomplete design. Components need reevaluation."}'

Output:
  { target: "analyze", reason: "...", knowledge_items: [...] }
  -> Transition to KNOWLEDGE_CAPTURE
